user.title: Map source
user.description: Where should the map come from? The Xiaomi cloud works with stock firmware. Local mode needs no Xiaomi account: it reads the map from Valetudo or from a local HTTP endpoint that serves a raw RRMap file. Stock robots do not expose their map locally.

cloud.title: Xiaomi account
cloud.description: Sign in with the Mi Home account that owns the vacuum. The credentials are only used to download the map from the Xiaomi cloud.

local.title: Local map source
local.description: No Xiaomi account is used. Valetudo robots answer at http://<robot-ip>/api/v2/robot/state/map. Alternatively point to any HTTP endpoint that returns a raw RRMap .gz/.bin file. Fill in the login only if the endpoint requires it.

device.title: Choose the vacuum
device.description: Pick the robot and enter its local IP address. The address is only used to ask the robot for the current map name.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the local IP address and the 32 character device token. The token is looked up in the cloud account to verify it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Xiaomi cloud rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current password.

error.two_factor: Xiaomi requires an additional confirmation. Open the link from the Home Assistant log on the device that owns the account, then retry.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Xiaomi cloud.
error.no_devices: No Roborock/Xiaomi vacuum was found in this account.
error.device_not_found: The vacuum was not found in the account.
error.invalid_token: The token must contain exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_host: Enter the local IP address of the vacuum.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_format: The endpoint answered, but the payload is neither a Valetudo map nor a valid RRMap file.

data.trim: Crop in percent: left, top, right, bottom
data.map_name: Map name override (leave empty for auto)
data.room_names: Room names, e.g. 1: Kitchen, 2: Living room
data.store_raw_map: Store the raw map on disk for diagnostics

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Returns the last rendered map as a base64 PNG together with the parsed map attributes.

refresh.name: Refresh map
refresh.description: Downloads the map immediately, ignoring the idle back-off.
